data.why: The repository ships its own synthetic demo_data/ (NetCDF model and obs grids) and app.py defaults VERIF_DATA_DIR/VERIF_OBS to that folder when the env vars are unset, so the UI opens with usable data with no uploads or extra files.

goals: Draw a verification region on the observation map and compute categorical scores (POD, FAR, CSI, ETS, HSS, PSS, ACC) at a chosen rainfall threshold
Compare forecast skill across leads (day1, day2, ...) or across multiple models for the same period
Assess ensemble calibration via reliability diagram, ROC/AUC, rank histogram, PIT histogram and spread-skill
Score probabilistic forecasts with Brier score, BSS and CRPS against observations
Run spatial verification (FSS skill vs neighbourhood scale, CRA displacement/volume/pattern decomposition) on a region
Quantify uncertainty with bootstrap confidence intervals on any score, and export score tables/figures

review.summary: The deterministic half is accurate, well evidenced, sensibly staged and labelled well: every screen I opened shows what its node claims. The tree misreports the demo data, though. The bundled 15-member ensemble was removed from the model list, so two of the six stated goals (probabilistic scores and ensemble calibration) are marked blocked when they were reachable. That phase needs a re-run before the tree is filed.
